propositions: A closed child with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) and a durable replacement link is exempt from completion verification in the close path but the certification path unconditionally requires a completion-verifier attestation on every closed child, creating an uncertifiable state

The exemption in transition_close.py:253-260 mints no completion-verifier attestation by design; reopening and re-closing produces identical outcome because the exemption branch executes every time, leaving no non-dishonest path to certification

child_closure_findings must resolve disposition-closed children through their replacement link—attesting the child's closure as certified iff the replacement's closure is certified-and-valid—rather than demanding an attestation the child is exempt from producing
A disposition close must now mint a completion-verifier attestation with manifest reading 'DISPOSITION <class>' plus the replacement id, NOT claiming a completion PASS that never occurred
The --force-close guard must run before the disposition branch so a forced close still withholds the signature and cannot become a verification bypass
